command:
bash -c '
ROOT=/Users/jkowals/Projects/USEO/rarog
source "$ROOT/scripts/xcode-toolchain.sh"
DEVELOPER_DIR="$(rarog_xcode_developer_dir)"; export DEVELOPER_DIR
xcrun swift test --package-path "$ROOT/native/Rarog/Packages/RarogUI" --filter "PendingMediaTests|PendingRowsTests|MediaRowsTests|SendCopyTests|TranscriptRowsTests" 2>&1 | grep -E "✘|Test run with|error:" | tail -5'
bash -c '
set -uo pipefail
ROOT=/Users/jkowals/Projects/USEO/rarog
source "$ROOT/scripts/xcode-toolchain.sh"
DEVELOPER_DIR="$(rarog_xcode_developer_dir)"; export DEVELOPER_DIR
LOCK=/tmp/rarog-ios-check.lock
until (umask 077 && mkdir "$LOCK") 2>/dev/null; do echo "czekam na blokadę"; sleep 15; done
(umask 077 && echo $$ >"$LOCK/pid" && echo "$ROOT" >"$LOCK/owner")
UDID=""
cleanup() { if [[ -n "$UDID" ]]; then xcrun simctl shutdown "$UDID" 2>/dev/null || true; xcrun simctl delete "$UDID" || true; fi; rm -f "$LOCK/pid" "$LOCK/owner"; rmdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || true; }
trap cleanup EXIT
UDID="$(xcrun simctl create rarog-merge "iPhone 17 Pro")"
LOG=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/rarog-merge.XXXXXX")
xcrun xcodebuild test -project "$ROOT/native/Rarog/Rarog.xcodeproj" -scheme Rarog "${RAROG_XCODE_PACKAGE_ARGS[@]}" -destination "id=$UDID" -only-testing:RarogUIKitTests/PendingMediaRowTests >"$LOG" 2>&1
echo "rc=$?"; grep -E "Test Case .*(passed|failed)|^/.*error:|error: -\[|\*\* TEST" "$LOG" | sort -u; rm -f -- "$LOG"'
